card.name: The end of the word lupus
card.fires_on: The final piece "us" that completes the word lupus after "Lup" or "lup". It appears in lupus nephritis, lupus erythematosus and lupus-like syndrome.

modes.label: Lupus as a warning term
modes.description: The word lupus completes in a list of adverse reactions, often as lupus-like syndrome.
modes.example: Autoimmunity: Stop Adalimumab-adaz if lup<<us>>-like syndrome or autoimmune hepatitis develop.

modes.label: Lupus as a diagnosis
modes.description: The word lupus completes in a disease name or a list of conditions, such as lupus nephritis or erythematosus.
